reason: Ear malformations and hearing loss define the disease. Developmental delay and hypogonadism each have reported frequencies of 30–79%, supporting neurologic and metabolic_endocrine involvement.
Parotid salivary gland infection supports gastrointestinal and infectious_immune primary labels. Other organ complications do not meet the common-involvement threshold.
Add metabolic_endocrine to primary: osteoporosis is a metabolic bone disorder. This axis includes metabolic disorders and does not require a separate endocrine gland disease.

corrected.basis: Osteoporosis is a metabolic bone disorder causing reduced bone strength and fragility fractures; premenopausal onset does not change its defining axes.

reason: The tumor originates in the cerebellum, supporting neurologic primary. Its prominent vascular component does not establish an additional cardiovascular disease.

Add musculoskeletal to primary: myelocystocele combines spinal cord malformation with a posterior vertebral closure defect. Its non-terminal location does not remove the defining spinal skeletal defect.

corrected.basis: Closed spinal dysraphism with a myelocystocele above the conus and an associated posterior vertebral defect; neural and spinal skeletal malformations define it.

reason: Bilateral peripheral vestibular loss defines the disease. Oscillopsia and imbalance reflect vestibular dysfunction without establishing separate ocular or neurologic organ damage.
Gonadal dysgenesis supports metabolic_endocrine through impaired gonadal hormone function. This subtype does not establish common skeletal damage merely through its Turner syndrome parent.
ANLN-associated glomerulosclerosis directly affects the kidneys. The supplied evidence establishes neither an immune mechanism nor additional organ involvement.

Intellectual developmental impairment defines the disease. Scoliosis in 6/10 and contractures in 4/10 support musculoskeletal involvement; mitral regurgitation in 3/10 meets the cardiovascular threshold.

Add haematologic to primary: SCID intrinsically impairs T- and B-lymphocyte function, making it a blood-cell disease as well as an immunodeficiency. Detectable cell counts do not exclude functional blood-cell disease.

corrected.basis: Combined T- and B-lymphocyte functional failure defines this immunodeficiency despite detectable cells; secondary infections do not establish additional common organ damage.
